The plate looks like a square side plate, about 22 cm across. It holds chopped egg whites (or a similar white food) and a scoop of orange mash, which could be hummus, sweet potato, or egg yolk mash.

The white pieces are probably egg whites, covering roughly 10x9 cm at a thickness of about 2 cm. I estimate that at about 100 g. The orange scoop is about 6x5 cm, around 50-60 g.

Egg white is about 52 kcal per 100 g, so 100 g gives roughly 50 kcal. If the white pieces are instead a soft cheese such as feta or tofu, the figure would be nearer 200 kcal. The orange part is probably a mash of yolks or sweet potato at about 150 kcal per 100 g, so 55 g gives about 80 kcal.

I'm treating the plate as egg whites plus a yolk mash, with a little uncertainty. The total is about 150 kcal over roughly 160 g. Allowing for the chance the white food is cheese, I'll nudge the estimate up to 180 kcal.

{"kcal": 180, "mass_g": 160}
